items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: his daughter is married to Mr. Weaver.

ctx.x: Stale Bread played piano, did he? Who?

Well, he used to play Black Keys, you know. Black Keys. Okay, alright. And he claims he wrote the voice, he's a creator of jazz. That out, I got a paper about it, and on his grave he's got something about that. See, his daughter is married to Mr. Weaver. And I was out to the side, Tony came out, or Cindy rather, and went to the grave and put some flowers on it.
It's the first time I've seen him in thirteen years.
